risk_note: RV2 (packages/domain + specs/state-machines; withdrawal state field). withdrawal.yaml transcribes BR-WDR-08 (7 states, W1–W11) in the CT-04a convention; the CT-04a generator now also emits withdrawal.gen.ts (table lookup only, guards as text). The generator discovers machines from the directory (B2-03j), so withdrawal needs no registration. W10 lists FAILED as an alternative target and the generated transitionWithdrawal takes an optional outcome checked against the row's targets, so a manual failure reaches FAILED through the generated transition (Codex money review round 1 S1, decision 3); without the outcome it returns the base target as the frozen rule tests require. The order and commission-rule-version generated files are byte-identical. No money arithmetic, no Date, no database or contract change.
